# easydns_subscription_service (Data Source)

```terraform
data "easydns_subscription_service" "current" {
  subscription_id = data.easydns_domain.example.subscription_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `subscription_id` (Number) Positive EasyDNS subscription block ID.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Service description.
- `enterprise` (Boolean) Whether this is an enterprise service.
- `name` (String) Service name.
- `period` (Number) Subscription term, usually in months.
- `service_id` (Number) Service ID supplied by the subscription.
- `size` (Number) Number of domains supported by the block.
